content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the Inca halls and let the old stones whisper their history."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stand by the white Christ and drink in the whole bowl of Cusco below."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A sweet little stop to learn how cacao becomes chocolate, with plenty of samples to keep the crew smiling."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":"m1","note":"A splash of modern Peruvian flavour from Gastón Acurio, where the plates are as colourful as Cusco itself."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Inca stonework so precise even a blade won't slip between the joins, with colonial arches resting on top."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"A weighty silver altar and a painting of the Last Supper with a very Andean guest on the plate."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Baskets of giant maize, pyramids of fruit and the hum of Quechua bargaining under one roof."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cyclopean stones fitted like a puzzle by hands that left no mortar and no easy answers."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cobbled lanes, tiny workshops and balconies painted the colour of a good sunset."}]}
A gentle Cusco wander, from Inca stones to market colours and one last view — every must-do snug inside.
